title: File:Pedra da Macela 1.jpg
claims: The photograph shows sunrise from Pedra da Macela: a granite ridge and rounded summit in the foreground, low cloud below, forested slopes and islands, and the Angra dos Reis bay in the distance under a pale sky.

Commons titles the file Pedra da Macela 1.jpg and describes it as sunrise at Pedra da Macela with a view towards the Baia de Angra dos Reis; it is categorised under Paraty and Pedra da Macela. It shows the summit setting and view, not the 2027 race, a timing point, aid station, course marking or race-day crowd.

The author is Rafael Defavari; the file is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; the photograph was taken on 2015-07-11; the original is 1,800 x 1,200 pixels and 1,318,504 bytes, and the file page gives no camera coordinates.
The route page uses a 960 x 640 copy of 127,498 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Rafael Defavari, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
